rules: Group-level answers (world, a region, an income group) come from aggregate_year, never AVG() over countries: per-person and % columns are not additive.
If the compiler must aggregate countries itself (e.g. a custom group), use SUM(x * population) / SUM(population) for weighted_avg measures.
Resolve 'latest'/'now'/'today'/no year to indicators.latest_year of the measure; 2025 only has population, GDP and urban data.
Put gdp_per_capita_usd on a log scale in scatter charts.
